key_facts: Aug 6 UPDATE (T+1d FINAL DAY; Exa Kashmir English Aug 6, Daily Qudrat Aug 6, Express Tribune Aug 4, 24Urdu Aug 4; UPDATED all-4 0.74->0.77): Kashmir English (Aug 6) reports AJK Election Commission issued its official and final stand categorically denying postponement rumors in 6 constituencies of Poonch division and ordering polling in all Poonch division constituencies to proceed on Aug 10 as scheduled. Daily Qudrat (Aug 6) details all 11 Phase-3 seats across Bagh, Haveli, Poonch, and Sudhanoti (LA-14 to LA-24; 208 candidates, 1.154M voters) set for Aug 10. Express Tribune (Aug 4) confirmed CEC Mughal said 3 Bagh seats, Haveli, and Abbaspur (Poonch) will vote Aug 10 with Baloch and Pallandri (Sudhnoti) also likely depending on security. Nudged all-4 up modestly 0.74->0.77 while retaining calibrated security-reversal hedges on Bagh and Haveli and Poonch (0.12), Bagh and Haveli (0.08), and Bagh and Haveli and Sudhnoti (0.02) (sum 0.99) ahead of Aug 7 resolution/final security notifications.
next_review_trigger: FINAL CHECK Aug 7: Watch for any AJK EC last-minute security postponement notification for Sudhnoti or Poonch constituencies.
